impacts.statement: The 10th Street bridge is flooded and impassable.
Much of Meeker between Highway 13 and the White River is flooded.
Water is close to the bottom of the 10th Street bridge.
The Highway 13 bridge on the west side of Meeker is flooded.
Many homes and property between Water Street and the White River are flooded.  8 Road is impassable.
Portions of 8 Road are flooded. Major flooding of property along the White River upstream and downstream of Meeker.
Water reaches the bottom of the Highway 13 bridge on the west side of Meeker.
Some driveways and private bridges along 8 Road north of Meeker are flooded.
Water will inundate portions of the Meeker City Park.
Flooding is affecting some riverside homes and structures along the White River in Meeker.
Minor flooding of low lying areas is occurring.  Portions of Meeker City Park are flooded.
The White River is over bankfull in spots resulting in minor flooding of low-lying farm land. Minor flooding of Meeker City Park is occurring.
The White River is close to bankfull in Meeker City Park. Some minor flooding of low-lying agricultural land is possible upstream and downstream of town.

value.label: North American Vertical Datum of 1988
value.description: A fixed reference for elevations determined by geodetic leveling. The datum was derived from a general adjustment of the first-order terrestrial leveling nets of the United States, Canada, and Mexico. In the adjustment, only the height of the primary tidal bench mark, referenced to the International Great Lakes Datum of 1985 (IGLD 85) local mean sea level height value, at Father Point, Rimouski, Quebec, Canada was held fixed, thus providing minimum constraint. NAVD 88 and IGLD 85 are identical. However, NAVD 88 bench mark values are given in Helmert orthometric height units while IGLD 85 values are in dynamic heights. See International Great Lakes Datum of 1985, National Geodetic Vertical Datum of 1929, and geopotential difference. NAVD 88 should not be used as Mean Sea Level.
